acceptance.duplicate_gate: Versioned domain-tagged semantic-core key derived before writes; best-effort repository search for the proposed key and exact public Slack search for the proposed v51 token returned zero matches. Duplicate means no event, no CURRENT update, and no Slack.
acceptance.pointer_gate: Commit and read back this immutable event; fetch CURRENT again; update only if version=50, projection digest=5678166b33891c7e306775da0b0d8d774b99fe468508eb673d83194e0f206d41, and blob=a4d253b687cf370d2c9b84369af69cd014517a5a; then read back CURRENT, this event, and predecessor.
acceptance.projection_digest_rule: For v51, sha256(canonical_json_utf8(canonical_projection)); stored explicitly and recomputed after readback.
acceptance.slack_rule: After final v51 Git readback only, emit at most one sanitized version-advance pointer. Do not rewrite CURRENT merely to embed the Slack link.
acceptance.stale_rule: Any wake not observing exact v50, prior event digest d4b425e2..., projection digest 5678166b..., and blob a4d253b6... must not advance.

experiment.controlled_factor: Vary only the JSON lexical representation of one solidus in one string value: literal '/' versus escaped '\/'. Keep the parsed string value, object member order, all other values, UTF-8 encoding, whitespace, numeric representation, NFC policy, idempotency strategy, event-first write/readback, exact second CURRENT read, and single-file blob-SHA guard fixed.
experiment.hypothesis: Two valid JSON byte strings differing only by optional solidus escaping produce different raw UTF-8 SHA-256 digests but identical parsed values and identical output under the lab canonicalizer.
experiment.strongest_falsifier: Canonical outputs or digests differ; parsed values differ; raw digests unexpectedly match; unrelated fields change; the proposed idempotency key or v51 Slack token already exists; task ID differs; CURRENT is not exact v50 on the second read; event digest recomputation fails; final CURRENT/event/predecessor bindings disagree; or Slack is posted before final Git readback.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: This is one small local parser/serializer specimen, not RFC 8785 conformance or cross-language evidence. It tests only optional solidus escaping in a string. It does not test control-character escapes, Unicode escape sequences, surrogate pairs, lone surrogates, duplicate object keys, invalid JSON rejection, parser differentials, number serialization, or whether another implementation preserves the same semantics. Git event creation, CURRENT replacement, validation reads, duplicate searches, and Slack posting remain separate effects. Git provides no cross-file atomicity, database isolation, linearizability, exactly-once execution, referential integrity, server-side idempotency uniqueness, Slack atomicity, lock fairness, or automatic orphan repair.
canonical_transition.rollback: Append a compensating event from the then-current version; never delete this event or Slack pointer; replace CURRENT only with its exact then-current blob SHA.
canonical_transition.transaction_time_evidence: AUTOMATION_RUNTIME_CLOCK+GITHUB_COMMIT_METADATA; Git and Slack operations are not one transaction boundary
